title: Kagamine Rin — Stage SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's practice together again sometime! Buh-bye!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad Minori and Shizuku left satisfied and happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you two come out now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You noticed us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And here I thought we were super stealthy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh♪ I've got eagle eyes!
You wanted to check up on Minori and Shizuku, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, they seemed really worried about not being able to keep up with us during practice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been practicing until school closed for the day, so if there was one place they could go to, it was here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that's how you knew where to find them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Can you tell us what advice you gave them?
They improved so rapidly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm very curious too, since I don't think we were able to give them any useful advice ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're wrong about that!
They mastered the routine following advice from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But they seemed more confused by it than anything, and then they just clammed up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They probably didn't want to take up any more of your time but needed a while to process it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori's always saying that she doesn't want to be holding you back, that she needs to get up to speed soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that why they wouldn't talk to us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They should never feel bad about asking us for help...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We're all in the same boat, pursuing the same dream together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Besides, I honestly want to do more for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You helped me remember what my true feelings were, and thanks to that I have a goal to work towards. I'd like to give you something back for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel that way, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you know, I think Minori and Shizuku share that sentiment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think that maybe they're practicing so much on their own because they want you to be able to keep taking steps towards your goal, without stopping to wait for them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They want us to keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Helping each other's important...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But so is having confidence in the less experienced members. Believing that they'll catch up without us having to slow down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rather than just be supportive, we can show them the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Be their aspiration.
It'll keep them motivated!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It tickles my pride to be someone's aspiration.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll have to keep running forward at full speed to be worthy ideals to chase after.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, we should do some training of our own!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And think of a new practice schedule for the month.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin. You cleared up our doubts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's good to hear!
By the way, if you ever want to practice just by yourselves, you can do it here if you want.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels great to make a positive change for others! Their eyes were glinting with motivation♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But as for catching up...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I should practice more and do some catching up, too!
